summary: Add a rebuildable canonical document graph with normalized hierarchy, exact identifiers, source spans, spatial bounds and local search projections.
decision_refs: User authorization on 2026-09-28 to regenerate all databases and fully replace the fragment-only storage design
Kapolei fixed-question validation identifying retrieval and sibling-context assembly as the dominant sampled failure
approval_evidence: The user explicitly instructed implementation to begin after approving full database regeneration.
known_limitations: The initial implementation projects existing parser evidence into the canonical graph; native CAD/BIM semantic relationships and local embeddings remain later stages.
The rebuild command creates and validates a separate staging database and does not cut over or delete the current local database automatically.
Visual model narration remains contextual and cannot become exact source text or an engineering fact.
